info.name: Shree Astro — User App
info.description:
Everything **user_app** calls.

## Start here
1. Select the **Shree Astro — Local** environment (top right).
2. Run *2 · Account → Register*. Tokens are saved for you.
3. Work down the folders in order — each one fills in the ids the next needs.

## Signing in without registering
*Request login OTP* saves the code to `{{devCode}}`, so *Verify OTP* works with no copying. Or put `{{masterOtp}}` (123456) in the code field — it works for any account while there is no SMS provider.

## Auth
Every request inherits `Authorization: Bearer {{userAccessToken}}` from this collection. Requests that must be anonymous override it themselves.

A 401 with `code: "token_expired"` means *refresh and retry* — run *Refresh tokens*. Any other 401 means sign in again.

## Before the directory has anyone in it
Only approved astrologers are listed. Register one with the Astrologer App collection and approve it with the Admin Panel collection first.

item.name: 2 · Account

request.description:
The seeker app's two-step wizard, sent as one request — both steps arrive together so an account is only ever created complete.

Sent as `multipart/form-data` because it carries the profile photo. Tick the `photo` row to attach one; it is optional.

Refusals: 409 if the email or number is already registered, 422 with per-field messages if anything is malformed.

exec: const save = (k, v) => (pm.environment.name ? pm.environment.set(k, v) : pm.collectionVariables.set(k, v));

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit code.

No SMS/email provider is wired up yet, so outside production the real code comes back as `devCode` and is also printed to the server log. This request saves it to `{{devCode}}`, so the next request works without copying anything.

`role` says which app is asking. `channel` is `phone` or `email`.

Refusals: 404 `account_not_found` (not registered — send them to Register), 403 `account_blocked`, 429 `otp_cooldown` (a code was sent less than 30s ago; `retryAfterSeconds` says how long to wait).

request.description:
Trades the code for a session and saves both tokens.

`{{devCode}}` was filled in by the previous request. `{{masterOtp}}` (123456) also works for any account while there is no SMS provider — swap it in to skip step 1 entirely.

Refusals: 400 wrong code (the message says how many attempts are left), 400 expired, 429 `otp_attempts_exceeded` after 5 wrong guesses — a resend clears the lockout.

item.name: 7 · Consultation

request.description:
What the Chat Intake screen sends.

Three checks run in order: the astrologer can take work, you can afford at least a minute, and you do not already have a chat open with them.

**The rate is fixed here**, so a price change mid-chat cannot affect what you pay. `freeMinutes` is the larger of the platform's first-consultation offer and whatever this astrologer grants — with free minutes available, an empty wallet is not a blocker.

`topic` must be one of the ids in models/constants.js.

request.description: Oldest first. The socket is the normal way to receive messages; this is how the screen fills in when it opens.

A fallback for sending without a socket — the socket path is the normal one. It still broadcasts, so the other side sees it live.

Only `text` is enabled right now; `image`, `audio`, `video` and `file` are defined but refused (400). Turn one on with `ENABLED_TYPES` in models/Chat.js.

`clientMessageId` makes a retry safe — resending the same id returns the message already stored instead of a duplicate.

Either side may end it. This is where the money moves:

1. duration is rounded **up** to the whole minute
2. free minutes come off
3. the rest is debited from the wallet
4. the astrologer is credited that, less commission

The answer carries the duration, what was charged and what the astrologer earned.
Only after it has ended, and only once (409 on a second try). The rating rolls into the astrologer's public average immediately.

request.description:
Open, so the app can show a reading before anyone signs in.

The same sign gets the same reading all day and a different one tomorrow. No astrology provider is connected yet — see services/horoscope.service.js for where it plugs in.

One thread per seeker, kept forever, so the conversation is still there when they come back. The first call opens it with the assistant's greeting already in place.

It is an ordinary chat with `type: 'ai'` and nobody on the other end, so the same message model and ordering apply. It is free — nothing is ever billed.
